description: Degraded network sensitivity under tc netem impairment (packet loss, RTT, jitter). Primary protocol: H3/QUIC (designed for lossy paths). Secondary: H1, H2 baselines. REQUIRES netem applied to loopback before run and impairment parameters in result metadata.

network_impairment.apply_command_template: sudo tc qdisc add dev lo root netem delay ${NETEM_DELAY_MS}ms ${NETEM_JITTER_MS}ms loss ${NETEM_LOSS_PCT}%
network_impairment.remove_command: sudo tc qdisc del dev lo root
network_impairment.metadata_capture: MANDATORY — NETEM_DELAY_MS, NETEM_LOSS_PCT, and NETEM_JITTER_MS must appear in result metadata. Run is invalid for comparison without captured impairment profile.

loopback_caveat: Impairment applied to loopback via tc netem. Does not model real network paths but provides reproducible controlled impairment.
key_metrics: http_req_failed rate — error ratio under loss
Throughput RPS degradation vs clean baseline

h1.note: TCP retransmission cost under loss. Baseline for comparison.

h2.note: TCP HOL-blocking becomes visible under loss.

h3.reason: H3/QUIC is the primary protocol for lossy-network. Driver (xk6-quic, h3load) not yet confirmed in runtime/drivers.

comparison_axis_note: Do NOT compare results across different netem profiles without explicit impairment-profile label. Do NOT compare loopback netem results to real network measurements.
